패션·화보 용어집이란 에디토리얼(화보) 제작 현장에서 실제로 쓰이는 용어: The Fashion & Editorial Glossary is a reference that sets out, in definition form, the terms actually used on editorial shoots. It contains 34 terms across four strands: editorial production, photography and post-production, style and trends, and industry roles. It was written by the
, which publishes more than 20 original editorials every month, and is maintained as of 2026.
에디토리얼(화보)이란 잡지나 매거진이 자체 기획으로 촬영·편집해 발행하는: An editorial is photo-led content that a magazine plans, shoots, edits and publishes on its own initiative. Unlike advertising, it is driven by the publication's editorial direction, and a credited team of photographer, stylist, model and others produces it under a single concept.
룩북이란 브랜드가 시즌 컬렉션의 착장을 순서대로 보여주기 위해 만드는 카: A lookbook is a catalogue-style shoot a brand produces to show the looks of a seasonal collection in order. It differs from an editorial in that its purpose is to convey information about the clothes themselves rather than to stage a story.
캠페인이란 브랜드가 시즌이나 제품을 알리기 위해 집행하는 광고 화보·영상: A campaign is an advertising photo or video project a brand runs to promote a season or product. The brand leads production and books the media, models and photographers, and unlike a magazine editorial it carries an advertising label.
커버 스토리란 매거진 한 호의 표지를 장식하는 인물·화보와 그에 딸린 메: A cover story is the person and shoot that grace the cover of a magazine issue, together with the accompanying main feature. It is the flagship content of the issue, commanding the largest production budget and page count.
무드보드란 촬영 전에 콘셉트·색감·조명·포즈의 방향을 이미지 모음으로 정: A moodboard is a planning document that gathers reference images to set the direction of concept, colour, lighting and poses before a shoot. It is the starting point of editorial production, ensuring the whole team goes into the shoot with the same picture in mind.
콜시트란 촬영 당일의 집합 시간·장소·인원·진행 순서를 한 장에 정리한: A call sheet is a one-page operations document listing the call time, location, crew and running order for the day of the shoot. It is the standard tool for preventing delays and confusion on larger editorial shoots.
크레딧이란 화보 제작에 참여한 사람과 역할(포토그래퍼·스타일리스트·헤어·: Credits are the list naming the people who took part in an editorial and their roles (photographer, stylist, hair, makeup, model and so on). They serve as each contributor's portfolio and the official record of creative contribution, and industry convention is to publish them alongside the work.
A statement is a short text in which the production team explains the concept and intent of an editorial in their own words. It gives readers and the publication a context for reading the work, and serves as the source text for search and citation.
테스트 슛이란 포토그래퍼·모델·스타일리스트가 포트폴리오를 위해 보수 없이: A test shoot is a collaborative shoot in which photographer, model and stylist share the results for their portfolios without payment. Also known as TFP (Time for Prints), it is the classic route by which emerging creatives build their careers.
서브미션이란 외부 크리에이티브 팀이 완성한 화보를 매거진에 게재 신청하는: A submission is the system by which an external creative team applies to have a finished editorial published in a magazine. The magazine reviews it against its editorial standards and decides whether to publish; PAP Magazine accepts submissions on its website at any time.
풀레터란 스타일리스트가 브랜드 의상을 촬영용으로 대여할 때 매체가 발급하: A pull letter is the official letter a publication issues when a stylist borrows garments from a brand for a shoot. It vouches for the identity behind the wardrobe loan (the pull) and specifies the publication, the placement and the return conditions.
하드 플래시란 플래시를 정면에서 강하게 터뜨려 진한 그림자와 또렷한 윤곽: Hard flash is a shooting technique that fires a strong flash head-on to create deep shadows and crisp outlines. It is used to give a direct, raw impression in paparazzi-style snaps and Y2K-mood editorials.
A softbox is a lighting modifier that wraps the light source in diffusion fabric to produce soft light. By blurring shadow edges it is widely used in beauty and portrait editorials where smooth skin rendering matters.
역광이란 피사체 뒤에서 빛을 비춰 윤곽선을 살리는 조명 방식이다. 실루엣: Backlight is a lighting setup that places the light behind the subject to bring out its outline. It emphasises the silhouette and the line of the hair, creating a dramatic atmosphere.
로우키란 어두운 톤을 기조로 명암 대비를 크게 가져가는 조명·노출 설계다: Low key is a lighting and exposure approach built on dark tones with strong contrast between light and shadow. It is used in editorials that call for weight and tension; its opposite is high key.
하이키란 밝은 톤을 기조로 그림자를 최소화하는 조명·노출 설계다. 깨끗하: High key is a lighting and exposure approach built on bright tones with shadows kept to a minimum. It gives a clean, light impression and is often used in beauty and commercial editorials.
필름 룩이란 필름 카메라 특유의 입자감(그레인)과 색 재현을 디지털에서: Film look refers to a texture that reproduces, in digital, the characteristic grain and colour rendition of film cameras. It creates images with a sense of time in editorials of a retro or analogue mood.
리터칭이란 촬영 원본의 피부·형태·배경을 다듬는 후반 보정 작업이다. 원: Retouching is the post-production work of refining skin, shapes and backgrounds in the original photographs. The standard is to raise the finish while preserving the impression of the original; excessive retouching can be subject to separate disclosure.
컬러 그레이딩이란 사진·영상의 색을 의도한 톤으로 통일하는 후반 작업이다: Colour grading is the post-production process of unifying the colours of photographs or video into an intended tone. It is the final step that sets the mood of the whole editorial, and its expressive range is wide enough that tones have names of their own, such as film look and teal-and-orange.
발레코어란 발레 연습복에서 온 리본·랩 톱·튤 스커트·새틴 슈즈를 일상복: Balletcore is a style that brings ribbons, wrap tops, tulle skirts and satin shoes from ballet rehearsal wear into everyday clothing. It peaked around 2022 and is characterised by soft fabrics and pastel tones.
고프코어란 등산·아웃도어 장비를 도시 패션으로 가져온 스타일이다. 기능성: Gorpcore is a style that brings hiking and outdoor gear into urban fashion. Technical jackets, trekking shoes and cargo silhouettes are its core elements.
Y2K란 2000년 전후의 로우라이즈·메탈릭·미니멀 테크 무드를 되살린: Y2K is a retro style that revives the low-rise, metallic and minimal-tech mood of the years around 2000. Together with hard-flash photography and glossy materials, it has been continually reinterpreted in editorials of the 2020s.
아방가르드란 실용성보다 조형적 실험을 앞세운 전위적 패션 경향이다. 과장: Avant-garde is an experimental fashion tendency that puts sculptural experimentation ahead of practicality. With exaggerated silhouettes and unconventional materials, it produces clothes closer to ‘clothes to look at’ than ‘clothes to wear’.
미니멀리즘이란 장식을 덜어내고 실루엣·소재·비례로 완성도를 만드는 스타일: Minimalism is a style that strips away ornament and achieves its finish through silhouette, material and proportion. It is characterised by neutral colours and restrained lines; at the opposite pole is maximalism.
맥시멀리즘이란 색·패턴·질감·액세서리를 겹쳐 과잉의 미학을 추구하는 스타: Maximalism is a style that layers colour, pattern, texture and accessories in pursuit of an aesthetic of excess. Summed up as ‘more is more’, it produces visually dense images in editorials.
젠더리스란 성별 구분 없이 입는 것을 전제로 디자인·스타일링하는 경향이다: Genderless is a tendency to design and style on the premise that clothes are worn regardless of gender. Silhouette experiments that cross the boundary between menswear and womenswear continue on both the runway and in editorials.
오트 쿠튀르란 고객 개인의 치수에 맞춰 손바느질 중심으로 제작하는 최고급: Haute couture is the highest grade of made-to-measure clothing, produced largely by hand to an individual client's measurements. The term may be used only by houses certified by the Fédération de la Haute Couture in Paris, and is distinct from ready-to-wear.
레디투웨어란 표준 치수로 대량 생산되는 기성복을 말한다. 프레타포르테라고: Ready-to-wear refers to clothing mass-produced in standard sizes. Also called prêt-à-porter, it is the commercial line at the heart of a seasonal collection.
A stylist is the professional who designs a person's entire look for editorials, stage and events. They borrow (pull) garments from brands and assemble the looks, and are a key credit in shaping the impression of an editorial.
아트 디렉터란 화보·지면의 시각적 방향을 총괄하는 책임자다. 콘셉트·레이: An art director is the person responsible for the overall visual direction of an editorial or page. From concept to layout and typography, they keep the visual language of the result consistent.
A makeup artist (MUA) is the professional in charge of makeup for editorials and stage. They design skin rendering and colour to suit the lighting, wardrobe and concept, and are listed in credits as MUA.
모델 에이전시란 모델의 매니지먼트와 캐스팅 연결을 담당하는 회사다. 화보: A model agency is a company that handles the management of models and connects them with castings. Convention is for editorial credits to list the model's agency alongside their name.
캐스팅 디렉터란 화보·쇼·캠페인에 맞는 모델과 인물을 찾아 연결하는 전문: A casting director is the professional who finds and connects the models and people suited to an editorial, show or campaign. The heart of the role is proposing faces that match the mood of the project.
포토 어시스턴트란 촬영 현장에서 조명 설치·장비 운용을 보조하는 스태프다: A photo assistant is a crew member who supports lighting setup and equipment handling on set. Many photographers gain on-set experience as assistants before going independent.
